summary.text: Thomas C. Alexander is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 1, which covers Oconee and Pickens Counties, serving since October 11, 1994.
His official page lists him as President of the Senate and chairman of the Interstate Cooperation and Legislative Oversight committees.

paragraphs.text: Alexander was born on July 25, 1956, in Seneca, and is a businessman and owner of Alexander's Office Supply.
His official page lists an A.A. from Anderson College in 1976 and a B.S. from Clemson University in 1978.
He served on the Walhalla City Council from 1982 to 1985 and in the S.C. House from 1987 to 1994.
He has been in the Senate since October 11, 1994.
His committees are Banking and Insurance, Ethics, Finance, Interstate Cooperation (chairman), Labor, Commerce and Industry, Legislative Oversight (chairman), and Medical Affairs.
